ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #17
====

GRADE: Grade 7
SUBJECT: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which response best shows understanding of Selected Chapters 90:1? (1 mark)

   B. Use Selected Chapters 90:1 to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of Selected Chapters 90:1 with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Say Selected Chapters 90:1 has no place in daily life.

   B. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   C. Skipping all moral lessons
   D. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school
